title: Java agent and SDK defaults
prompt: An application uses OpenTelemetry Java agent 2.x. OTLP protocol, trace exporter, propagators, and trace sampler are unset. OTEL_SERVICE_NAME is checkout, while OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES contains service.name=cart. Using the supplied documentation, return only JSON with exporter_protocol, effective_service_name, traces_exporter, propagators, and traces_sampler.
agent_section: For OpenTelemetry Java agent 2.x, the default OTLP protocol is `http/protobuf`, not `grpc`. If both `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` and a `service.name` entry in `OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES` are present, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` takes precedence, so the effective service name is the value of `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`. With the corresponding SDK environment variables unset, the trace exporter defaults to `otlp`, the propagators default to `tracecontext,baggage`, and the trace sampler defaults to `parentbased_always_on`. An empty environment-variable value is interpreted in the same way as an unset variable.
